title: Udhiyah checker and ten days plan
subject: Islamic Studies
source: Seeded from islamic-studies/y8 lesson 25 (Pupil PDF worksheet: udhiyah checker and ten days plan)
intro: Lesson 25: Dhul-Hijjah and the udhiyah: worship with conditions. To understand the virtue of the first ten days of Dhul-Hijjah and the conditions that make the udhiyah valid

questions.q: Apply the two conditions of acceptance to the udhiyah.
questions.a: Ikhlas: offered for Allah, not to show off; following the Sunnah: the right animal, age, soundness and time, with bismillah and takbir.
questions.model: Point 1: ikhlas. Develop: 'what reaches Him is taqwa from you' (22:37). Point 2: following the Sunnah. Develop: after the Eid prayer (Bukhari and Muslim), a sound animal of the right age.

questions.q: How many people can share a cow?

Udhiyah checker on the pupil PDF: judge five cases (a lame sheep; a goat of eight months; slaughter on the 12th after Eid; a cow shared by seven; slaughter at Fajr on Eid day) as valid or not, with the reason. Then write a ten days plan in the portal response box.
questions.a: Not valid (lame); not valid on the common view (goat under 1 year); valid (tashriq); valid; not valid (before the prayer)
questions.model: Teacher does case 1: 'Lame sheep: not valid, because a clearly lame animal is one of the defects scholars list.'

questions.q: what is the ruling on cutting hair and nails for one who will sacrifice?
questions.a: He avoids it from the 1st of Dhul-Hijjah until he sacrifices (Muslim)

questions.q: Fasting the Day of Arafah expiates ...
questions.a: The year before and the year after
options: The year before and the year after

questions.q: Back to our ponder: does the timing of the udhiyah matter?
questions.a: Yes: it must be after the Eid prayer
